simple.meaning: קֻבַּעַת (qubbaʻath) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a goblet (as deep like a cover ).” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Isaiah 51:17. The background is built from the passages where the word occurs.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קֻבַּעַת (H6907) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: קֻבַּעַת (qubbaʻath) / H6907 is traced through Isaiah 51:17, Isaiah 51:22 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.short: a goblet (as deep like a cover )
definitions.full: H6907. qubbaath קֻבַּ֫עַת noun feminine cup (perhaps loan-word from Assyrian [ ‡abu°tu ], plural ‡abûâtê , probably cups, goblets ; compare Arabic flower-cup, calyx ); — construct ק ׳הַתַּרְעֵלָה כּוֺס Isa 51:17 compare 51:22 (both figurative, and כּוֺס in both probably explanatory gloss, see Commentaries).
